data.name: Haida
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word ‘haid’, meaning ‘to guide’ or ‘to help’. In Islamic tradition, Haida is a name for a compassionate and trustworthy guide who leads one to the right path in life. The name evokes images of a wise and caring mentor, always ready to offer guidance and support.
